summary.intent: Resolve PR review threads and refine label handling logic in the pr-release-preview.js script.
summary.outcome: All 4 PR threads were replied to and resolved; the label preservation approach was reverted in favor of the simpler original removal logic.

repo: pr-release-preview.js handles label logic for PR release previews, including manual tag overrides.
The repo uses GitHub Actions scripts under .github/scripts/.

code.finding: Label preservation logic was added to handle manual tag overrides, but was reverted because the simpler removal approach is preferred — developers can reapply manual tags after the last commit if needed.

workflow: PR review threads were resolved programmatically via Bash commands.
Design decisions with low frequency use cases (like manual tag override preservation) are being deferred rather than adding complexity to the current implementation.

friction: The label preservation fix was initially applied but then deemed unnecessary complexity for a rare scenario, requiring a revert.
open_items: Label preservation on manual tag overrides: after the last commit, developers must reapply manual tag changes since the removal logic clears them. This behavior could be improved in a future iteration.
